|---|---|---|---|
| **Window size** `size` | 3 | 3 to 7, odd px | The neighbors are this window without its center pixel. |
| **Threshold** `threshold` | 50 | 1 to 255 | How far a channel may differ from the neighbor median before the pixel counts as defective. |
| **Show** `output` | Repaired image | Repaired image, Detected pixels | Show the repaired image, or white dots where defects were found. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
